## Pins

- r-mclust 6.1.1 (conda-forge). mclust >= 6.1.2 names columns from deparse(call$data), which fails when the matrix arrives through rpy2 without column names, as in GraphST.utils.mclust_R
- rpy2 3.5.17 (PyPI sdist built against the environment's R). rpy2 3.6 raises on numpy2ri.activate(), which GraphST.utils.mclust_R calls
